newsitem.title: UK: BT down on windfall tax worries.
newsitem.headline: BT down on windfall tax worries.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc dipped in early trade on Thursday after a television report that the company would be subject to Labour's planned "windfall" tax on utilities, dealers said.
The stock was down 7p at 471 by 0755 GMT in active trade of 1.9 million shares.

A report by Independent Television News quoted unnamed government sources that BT would be included in the companies targetted by the windfall tax, designed to finance training and job creation measures, in the July 2 budget.
BT, however, said it did not expected to be subject to the tax, arguing that it was not a monopoly. A spokeswoman said the company would consider a legal challenge if it was targeted by the tax.
